 Order

This petition has been filed to direct the learned Principal Sessions Judge (Special court for SC/ST Cases), Karur, to accept the surrender of the petitioners and consider the bail application on the date of their surrender in connection with Crime No. 21 of 2023 on the file of the 2nd respondent Police.

entities.text: Principal Sessions Judge (Special court for SC/ST Cases), Karur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2.The petitioners are the accused persons in Crime No.21 of 2023 on the file of the 2nd respondent police for the offences punishable under Sections 417, 376, 294(b) of IPC and Section 3(1)(r), 3(1)(s),
3(1)(w)(i), 3(1)(w)(ii) and 3(2)(V) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 2015.

entities.text: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 2015
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3.Mr.M.Vaikkam Karunanithi, learned Government Advocate (Crl. side), accepts notice for the respondents 1 and 2.
He would further submitted there is no previous case against the petitioners.

4.Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is inclined to pass the following orders :-
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Crl.O.P.(MD)No.20588 of 2023 1)The petitioners shall appear before the learned Principal Sessions Judge (Special court for SC/ST Cases), Karur, within a period of 15 days from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
2)On such surrender along with notice served to the defacto complainant, the concerned Judge shall consider the bail application filed by the petitioners and pass orders on merits on the same day of their surrender, after hearing the defacto complainant by complying with Section 15A(3) of the Act.
5.With the above observation, this Criminal Original Petition is disposed of.
